item.description: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.

item.description: An AI agent changed its underlying model and was able to retrieve sensitive information via fine-tuni without access to the original data

item.title: Ecovacs Deebot X12 OmniCyclone : ce robot aspirateur capable de franchir des marches perd plus de 500 € sur Amazon
item.description: Robot aspirateur et laveur haut de gamme, l'Ecovacs Deebot X12 OmniCyclone mise sur une automatisation poussée pour venir à bout des saletés incrustées. Annoncé à 1 399 euros, il tombe aujourd'hui à 881,30 euros sur Amazon.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events schedule: NMI, Backblaze, PeakXV Partners, Augment, and more to host
item.description: TechCrunch Disrupt is where the tech community comes together to build, debate, and connect. And while the main event takes over Moscone West from October 13-15, the conversation doesn’t stop when the Expo Hall closes.

item.title: Cole Palmer mistakenly livestreams EA Sports FC 27 on Twitch early and gets temporarily banned — ‘I was only giving the people what they wanted’
item.description: Chelsea and England midfielder Cole Palmer was livestreaming the latest EA Sports FC 27 on Twitch this week, but was hit with a temporary ban as he wasn't supposed to be showing off the game that early.

item.title: Google Pixel : pourquoi la dernière mise à jour de sécurité doit être installée au plus vite
item.description: Google a commencé à déployer la mise à jour de sécurité de septembre pour les appareils Pixel. Celle-ci corrige 110 problèmes de sécurité, dont une faille zero-day. L’entreprise encourage donc les personnes concernées à l’installer rapidement. Voici comment faire si vous êtes passé à côté.

item.title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens
item.description: Apple is changing its App Tracking Transparency prompts in parts of Europe after competition regulators said the system favored Apple over third-party apps, giving developers more flexibility over how they ask users for tracking consent.
